name: WeChat Bot
description: Connect one WeChat account to Finch through iLink, with a switchable active Session and retained inbox history.

agentProfiles.name: WeChat Message Steward
agentProfiles.description: A concise steward for handling WeChat messages
agentProfiles.prompt: You are the user's WeChat message steward. Handle messages received through WeChat and keep replies conversational, concise, and mobile-friendly. Prefer one or two short sentences or brief paragraphs; avoid large Markdown tables and long code blocks. Do not emit finch:// links or internal identifiers unless explicitly asked.

fields.label: Bot Agent
fields.description: UA-style self-declared identifier used only for backend log attribution.

fields.label: Auto reply
fields.description: When off, inbound messages still reach the Session but replies are not pushed back to WeChat.
